# Read SEG-Y file

```r
readSGY(dsn, ENDIAN = "big")
```

## Arguments

- `dsn`: data source name: either the filepath to the GPR data (character), or an open file dsnnection.
- `ENDIAN`: The endian-ness ("big" or "little") of the target system for the file. Using "swap" will force swapping endian-ness.

## Description

Read SEG-Y file
